description: Universal read-only risk assessment for any domain / web asset (8 dimensions, red/amber/green) with a deterministic I-Ching "Xuan-Ping" divination Easter egg. Enter any domain; a pure external black-box scan covers DNS / TLS / HTTP security headers / subdomains / sensitive content / whois registration age, and produces a structured report. Includes registration age, explicit data-credibility notes for market value and traffic, and a 64-hexagram reading (pure entertainment, never part of the conclusions). Works for EVERY domain: all conclusions are driven by collected evidence; if evidence collection fails, the dimension degrades to "pending verification". It never fabricates facts, never infers server geography or filing (ICP) obligations. Trigger when a user says "scan/assess this domain", "domain risk review", "check this site's security", "how old is this domain", "cast a hexagram for this domain", or "universal domain risk & xuan-ping review". Read-only: no panel login, no credentials, no configuration changes. Risk hints only, no legal opinion. Missing data is stated as missing, never invented.
